   doctrines and ceremonies; pertaining to popery; popish; -- used
   disparagingly.

papistry.definition:
n. The doctrine and ceremonies of the Church of Rome;
   popery.
papistry.translation: n. 天主教, 天主教教义

papists.definition:
plural of papist
n. an offensive term for Roman Catholics; originally, a Roman Catholic who was a strong advocate of the papacy
papists.translation: (papist 的复数) n. 教皇制信奉者, 天主教徒

papooses.definition:

papovavirus.definition: n any of a group of animal viruses associated with or causing papillomas or polyomas
papovavirus.translation: n. [微]乳头(状瘤)多瘤空泡(形)病毒,乳多空病毒

papula.definition:
n. A pimple; a small, usually conical, elevation of the
   cuticle, produced by congestion, accumulated secretion, or hypertrophy
   of tissue; a papule.
n. One of the numerous small hollow processes of the
   integument between the plates of starfishes.
papula.translation:
n. 丘疹, 面泡, 长疮
[医] 丘疹

papula agria.translation: [医] 疱疹性丘疹, 疱疹性苔癣

papula madidans.translation: [医] 湿丘疹, 扁头湿疣

papular.definition:
a. Covered with papules.
a. Consisting of papules; characterized by the presence of
   papules; as, a papular eruption.

papular scrofuloderma.translation: [医] 丘疹性皮肤结核, 瘰疬性苔癣

papular syphilid.translation: [医] 丘疹性梅毒疹, 梅毒性苔癣

papyraceous.definition: a. Made of papyrus; of the consistency of paper; papery.

a. 纸质的, 薄如纸的
[医] 纸状的

papyri.translation: 纸莎草; 大伞莎草（papyrus的名词复数）

papyrine.definition:
n. Imitation parchment, made by soaking unsized paper in
   dilute sulphuric acid.

papyrograph.definition:
n. An apparatus for multiplying writings, drawings, etc.,
   in which a paper stencil, formed by writing or drawing with corrosive
   ink, is used. The word is also used of other means of multiplying
   copies of writings, drawings, etc. See Copygraph, Hectograph, Manifold.
papyrograph.translation: n. 复写器, 简易胶版

papyrographed.translation: n. 复写器；复写版；简易胶版

papyrography.definition:
n. The process of multiplying copies of writings, etc.,
   by means of the papyrograph.
papyrography.translation: [医]纸分配层析（法）, 纸分配色谱（法）

papyrologist.translation: n. 故纸文献考证工作者；坏纸文献考证学家, 莎草纸古文稿学者

papyrus.definition:
n. paper made from the papyrus plant by cutting it in strips and pressing it flat; used by ancient Egyptians and Greeks and Romans
n. tall sedge of the Nile valley yielding fiber that served many purposes in historic times
n. a document written on papyrus
papyrus.translation: n. 纸草, 草制成之纸
